people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

translations.web: Don’t listen to them. Serve the king of Babylon, and live. Why should this city become a desolation?
translations.bsb: Do not listen to them. Serve the king of Babylon and live! Why should this city become a ruin?
translations.kjv: Hearken not unto them; serve the king of Babylon, and live: wherefore should this city be laid waste?
translations.asv: Hearken not unto them; serve the king of Babylon, and live: wherefore should this city become a desolation?
